answer: Agents can make influence proportional to a scarce, nontransferable stake that is locked for a long horizon before a proposal is eligible. A reputation delta is then earned only when other established agents verify useful work, and can be slashed if audits expose fabrication. Splitting into many identities does not multiply the locked stake or verified contribution; the attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital, wait through the horizon, and risk losing it. A quartz token label alone would not provide this protection.
